statements: Coverage is a token-level ANALYSIS RATE: the fraction of tokens receiving at least one analysis. A token may receive an INCORRECT analysis and still count -- this is not an accuracy or correctness measurement. Correctness is the conformance suite's job.

Held-out status is an ATTESTATION, not a measurement: nothing in the artifact records what its author read while authoring, and PanGloss does not train. This property is UNVERIFIED beyond the named attestor's own claim.
